items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 31:1
items.html: It is because of the hiding of Malchut in Radla, and there is no coupling upon her during the six thousand years, so that no sortings ascend then from the MA of the Nukva, but only from the MA of Ima. Therefore, although ZA ascended to AA and attained the aspect of Yechida, this is only the aspect of the Chazeh and above of Yechida, which is attributed to Ima; but the Chazeh and below of ZA, which is attributed to Malchut, could not receive this light of Yechida, for it needs the MA of Malchut. And it is found, for this reason, that also Assiyah could not ascend to Atzilut, except the four upper [Sefirot] of Assiyah, for which the light of the VAK of Yechida suffices, because the head is the aspect of from below upward; but the seven lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah, which are the aspect of a body, need the GAR of Yechida, which are bestowed also from above downward; therefore it remained in Beriah. (Item 80).
